releaseNotes: ROBLOX IS SUPPORTED — removed from the blocked list and verified as a curated clone (username + password login). Clone Roblox exactly like Discord: unlimited parallel installs, separate accounts per clone.

SPLIT-SCREEN + SMALL-SCREEN UNLOCK FOR ROBLOX — the stock Roblox app ships locked (resizeableActivity=false, smallScreens=false, min-width 300dp), which is why it refuses split-screen and small windows. Every Ophelia Roblox clone rewrites all three locks in the manifest, so your clone runs side-by-side with anything, in any window size. Verified against the real Roblox 2.740.931 build.

DISCORD QUICK MENU (account switcher, rebuilt) — hold your own profile tab (bottom-right) and a Discord-style menu opens: SET STATUS (Online / Idle / Do Not Disturb / Invisible with the exact presence dots) and SWITCH ACCOUNTS below it. Status rows call Discord's own settings API; when the live token can't be read from inside the app they gracefully open your profile instead. The switcher is now Discord-only and inert everywhere else, exactly as designed.

Bug scan round across the whole family: this cloner release also hardens the patcher self-check (the new resize tests run in CI on every push) and fixes a stuck-drawer state in the switcher host plus a slot-naming off-by-one.
Cloning engine untouched where it was already solid — everything that worked in v1.9.0 works exactly the same.
